prompt: A portrait game screen of a busy restaurant kitchen line seen from a high three-quarter angle: left to right a flat-top grill, a deep fryer, a two-burner saute station and a stainless steel pass window, with white paper order tickets clipped along a rail across the top. Two line cooks in stained white jackets and black skull caps work the line, one flipping a burger on the grill, one lifting a fry basket, with orange flame and steam rising. Hand-painted gouache illustration with loose visible brushwork and confident inked contour lines, gritty and lived-in: grease-streaked steel, worn black rubber floor mats, a scuffed white tile wall. Late Friday-night service light: a warm orange glow from the grill and heat lamps against cool blue-green fluorescent light overhead, with deep shadows pooling in the corners. A clean open floor across the lower third.
